Gemini CLI: which KYA replays were tested

Replays tested on Gemini CLI

No replay has run on Gemini CLI. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Gemini CLI.

What the Gemini CLI setup page says about coverage

On the MCP path, Gemini's built-in tools only reach KYA when they go through MCP. The extension's hook also sees native tool calls, but it is advisory: it records them and blocks the never-list and the guard pack. trust: false keeps Gemini's own confirmation layer intact on top.

Source: the Gemini CLI recipe.

Install

The plugin for Gemini CLI:

gemini extensions install https://github.com/The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
